mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.5% within the last month signals a tightening monetary policy, which increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS increased by more than 0.5% in the last month.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate by more than 0.3% within the last three months signals a tightening labor market, which increases wage costs and boosts consumer spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances where UNRATE decreased by more than 0.3% in the last three months.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in real estate sales by more than 5% within the last two months signals a strengthening housing market, which boosts consumer confidence and spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances where HOUST increased by more than 5% in the last two months.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in industrial production by more than 2% within the last month signals a weakening supply side, which may lead to inflationary pressures and reduced corporate profits, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where INDPRO decreased by more than 2% in the last month.

mechanism_narrative: An always-on mechanism where a high level of nonfarm payrolls (above 155,000) signals strong labor market conditions, which supports consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances where PAYEMS is above 155,000.

mechanism_narrative: An interaction-driven mechanism where a simultaneous increase in real GDP and decrease in retail sales signals a shift in consumer spending patterns, which may lead to a re-allocation of capital and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 increases and RSAFS decreases simultaneously
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where GDPC1 increases and RSAFS decreases simultaneously.

mechanism_narrative: An interaction-driven mechanism where a simultaneous increase in the federal funds rate and a decrease in the consumer price index signals a potential deflationary environment, which may lead to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS increases and CPIAUCSL decreases simultaneously
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS increases and CPIAUCSL decreases simultaneously.

mechanism_narrative: A regime-conditional mechanism where a decrease in the unemployment rate by more than 0.5% during a period of economic expansion signals a tightening labor market, which increases wage costs and boosts consumer spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances where UNRATE decreased by more than 0.5% during an economic expansion.
